audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5, Level 6 and 2+ items read Volibear/Volibear/Skill in both layers, against the packet chart (Skill / Skill / Zaahen) and against the mirror, which already set those three rows from Volibear's side.
audit.why: The content whys for those rows already say 'level back to even', 'even/skill' and 'you take over' — the tokens contradicted their own text.
audit.corrected: win[3]/phases[3].side and win[4]/phases[4].side -> Skill, win[6]/phases[6].side -> Zaahen, one atomic group, with ratings moved to 5/10, 5/10 and 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 text said Stormbringer 'shields him' and that Zaahen's R 'steals stats'; neither is in either kit.
audit.why: Riot's Stormbringer text: leap, slow, damage, bonus Health, and nearby enemy towers disabled — the shield in his kit is on Sky Splitter (E) and only if he is inside the blast. Zaahen's R deals damage and heals for a portion of it. Stormbringer is 160/135/110s, so a wasted one is a two-and-a-half-minute hole.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, whys[4] and mid rewritten with the real effects and the 160s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Frenzied Maul was described as healing off an 'execute proc' — the kit says the recast on a marked target deals bonus damage and heals him, with no execute component. Thundering Smash's auto-attack reset and its 300-range limit were never stated, and the W's on-hit application was missing.
audit.why: Q is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s at 300 range and resets his attack, so the wind-up is the trade tell, and holding a gap larger than 300 removes his opener entirely. W is a 5s cooldown that applies on-hit effects, so his damage scales with attack speed and armour alone reads the trade wrong (both flagged in missingInteractions).
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1], dosFull[0..2].d, dontsFull[0..2].d and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Anti-heal his W heal' had placeholder text under it.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul is a 5s heal — Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d names the cooldown and Executioner's.

edits.before: Level 6 is even/skill — his Stormbringer dive versus your R stat-steal all-in is a coin-flip.
edits.after: Level 6 is even/skill — his Stormbringer dive versus your R's damage-and-heal is a coin-flip.

edits.before: Level 6 is even — his Stormbringer (R) leap disables your towers and shields him, but your R Final Retribution can out-heal and steal stats in the bruiser mirror; bait his Q stun then ult, and don't fight under his R's tower-disable dive.
edits.after: Level 6 is even — Stormbringer (R, 160s at rank 1) leaps in, slows, hands him bonus health and disables your towers, while your R heals off the damage it deals; bait the Q stun first, then ult, and never fight under his dive.

edits.before: Level 3 stays Volibear's as his full Q-W chase-and-heal wins extended trades. At 4-5 it levels back toward even as your Q poke and E burst come online off his engage windows, and level 6 is a coin-flip — his R dive versus your R stat-steal all-in decides the fight.
edits.after: Level 3 stays Volibear's as his full Q-W chase-and-heal wins extended trades. At 4-5 it levels back toward even as your Q poke and E burst come online off his engage windows, and level 6 is a coin-flip — his 160-second R dive versus your R's damage-and-heal decides it.

edits.before: Self-heal with Frenzied Maul's execute proc in trades
edits.after: Recast Frenzied Maul on the mark to heal off you

edits.before: His engage. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Q is 12s at rank 1 and only 300 range. Step in after it.

edits.before: Probe Volibear's pattern early, then commit your full combo only on his key cooldown — bank knowledge before blood.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is an auto reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is the tell; break his path and the stun never lands.

edits.before: Volibear wastes Thundering Smash (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul is 5s and heals on the recast — Executioner's before you commit.

edits.before: That is Volibear's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Q only reaches 300 units — keep that gap and his whole combo has no opener.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: W applies on-hit and scales with his attack speed, not just AD.

edits.before: Coin-flipping into an unknown matchup — respect what you have not seen until you have seen it twice.
edits.after: Stormbringer grants him bonus health and disables your towers — never take that fight at low HP.

edits.before: - Volibear Thundering Smash: matchup-defining — His engage. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Volibear Thundering Smash: 12s at rank 1, 300 range — an auto reset; the wind-up is the tell. - Frenzied Maul: 5s, heals on the recast. - Sky Splitter: 16s, shields him if he stands in it. - Your R: kill windows.

notes: Two invented mechanics removed: Frenzied Maul has no execute proc (recast on a marked target damages and heals), and Stormbringer grants bonus health, not a shield — the shield is on Sky Splitter and only when he stands in his own blast. Zaahen's R was again written as a stat-steal; it deals damage and heals. All three packet suspectNames for this matchup are FALSE POSITIVES — Thundering Smash and Frenzied Maul are the real names, matched with possessives or a leading verb.
